arrival_model: Paced bounded closed-loop; late arrivals wait at client and are recorded. Not independent open-loop offered load.
credentials: Ephemeral environment-only keys are generated by server_session and never written to protocol, evidence, or command lines.
limitations: One arm per engine/rate, no repeated estimates or stable tail-latency claim.
Server queue histogram deltas include the two warmup requests.
The listed target rate need not be achieved and need not cause rejection.

prompts.content: Assess the enterprise incident. Return only a JSON object with category, severity, summary, evidence (array of verbatim input quotes), recommended_action, confidence, and requires_human_review (boolean). Categories: inventory_sync_failure, inventory_discrepancy, fulfillment_failure, payment_processing_error, shipment_delay, transaction_missing, api_failure, unknown. Severity: low, medium, high, or critical. Confidence: low, medium, or high. Use only evidence in the report. Recommendations are advisory and must not execute actions.
Order 18422 is unfulfilled. Warehouse reports no stock, inventory shows 12 units, latest sync timed out.
